Question: assalamu alaikum im student how can i increase my memory and concentration in studies.i my sself forgetting my subject even exam time facing this more? Answer ID: 24860 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1758/1286/H=1431) Offer salah regularly and shun sins. After each salah, recite the following verse thrice with durood 3-3 times before and after: قَالَ رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي . وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي . وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي . يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي . (سوره طه ركوع 2) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
